title: Fast intention route has no direct regression coverage
reasoning: The new route is exposed at fasts/<int:fast_id>/intention/, but the included fast view tests only import and exercise FastListView, FastByFeastDateView, and FastSerializer behavior. None of the linked tests resolve or request the fast-intention URL, so a URL name/path regression or a mismatch between the route kwarg fast_id and the view's expected kwarg could ship without these tests failing.
recommendation: Add focused tests for the fast-intention endpoint that use the declared route or reverse name, cover a successful request, a nonexistent fast_id, and the expected authentication/authorization behavior for this user-input route.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover adjacent fast listing, feast-date filtering, and serializer day-number behavior, but no test references fast-intention or /api/fasts/<id>/intention/.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests in hub/tests/test_fast_views.py that call reverse('fast-intention', kwargs={'fast_id': fast.id}) or GET /api/fasts/{fast.id}/intention/ and assert the intended status code and response contract.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering hub/urls.py route wiring and FastIntentionView endpoint behavior.
